description: WASK helps marketers and businesses manage, analyze, and optimize Google Ads and Meta Ads directly in ChatGPT. Users can monitor campaign performance, analyze key PPC metrics, identify optimization opportunities, optimize advertising budgets, and improve ROAS with AI-powered insights. Analyze ad creatives, identify top-performing ads, and get AI-powered recommendations to improve existing creatives. Connect your Google Ads and Facebook Ads accounts to automate workflows, discover underperforming campaigns, and simplify daily PPC management with WASK's AI Ads Agent.

defaultPrompt: How did my Google and Meta ad campaigns perform in the last 14 days?
Which are my top and bottom performing campaigns this month?
Show me keywords with high spend but no conversions, and suggest which to pause.
